teaser.en: Breakfast on the coast often means *mbaazi za nazi*, pigeon peas simmered in coconut milk and eaten with *mahamri*.
teaser.sw: Kifungua kinywa cha pwani mara nyingi humaanisha *mbaazi za nazi*, mbaazi zilizopikwa taratibu kwa tui la nazi na kuliwa pamoja na *mahamri*.
teaser.dg: Pwani, chai ya ligundzu mara nyinji ni *mbaazi za nazi*: mbalazi zirizojitwa na huwi na kuriwa phamwenga na *mahamri*.

summary.en: *M'balazi* is the pigeon pea, a hardy shrubby pulse grown on farm edges across the coast. Its peas, cooked in coconut milk, are part of the classic coastal breakfast.
summary.sw: *M'balazi* ni mbaazi, jamii ya kunde inayofanana na kichaka na inayostahimili hali ngumu, inayolimwa pembezoni mwa mashamba kote pwani. Mbaazi zake, zikipikwa kwa tui la nazi, ni sehemu ya kifungua kinywa maarufu cha pwani.
summary.dg: *M'balazi* ni muhi wa mbalazi, chitsaka chigumu cha jamii ya kunde chinachophandwa maso ga minda kosi pwani. Mbalazi, zichijitwa na huwi, ni seemu ya chai ya ligundzu ya kawaida ya pwani.

about.en:
*M'balazi* is a woody shrub 1 to 3 m tall, with leaves of three narrow, soft leaflets and bright yellow flowers, sometimes streaked with red. The flowers are followed by flat, hairy pods with constrictions between the seeds.

The peas come in different colours, and Digo farmers name them by colour: *nyereru*, *mnjindo* and *bombo*.
about.sw:
*M'balazi* ni kichaka chenye shina gumu kama la mti chenye urefu wa mita 1 hadi 3, chenye majani ya vijani vitatu vyembamba na laini na maua ya manjano angavu, wakati mwingine yenye michirizi myekundu. Baada ya maua huja makaka bapa yenye manyoya, yaliyobanwa kati ya mbegu moja na nyingine.

Mbaazi huwa na rangi tofauti, na wakulima Wadigo huzipa majina kulingana na rangi: *nyereru*, *mnjindo* na *bombo*.
about.dg:
*M'balazi* ni chitsaka chigumu cha mita mwenga hadi tahu. Makodzage ganamera mahahu-mahahu, membamba na malaini, na maruwage ni ga rangi ya mandano inayoala, wakati wanjina na mistari ya kundu. Maruwa gachimala, kunamera makakaya ga bapa genye nyere, ganayokala membamba kahi ya tembe na tembe.

Mbalazi zina rangi za tafwauti, na akurima a Adigo anaziiha kpwa rangi zao: *nyereru*, *mnjindo* na *bombo*.

where.en: Look for *m'balazi* on the edges of farms and around homesteads, where it often stands as a living border. It is drought-tolerant and keeps going on dry, sandy ground after other crops have finished.
where.sw: Tafuta *m'balazi* pembezoni mwa mashamba na kuzunguka maboma, ambako mara nyingi husimama kama ua hai. Huvumilia ukame na huendelea kustawi kwenye ardhi kavu ya mchanga baada ya mazao mengine kumaliza msimu wake.
where.dg: Unaweza kuuona *m'balazi* maso ga minda na kuzunguluka midzi, ambapho mara nyinji unaima dza lichigo hai. Unavumirira ukame, na unaenderera kumera kpwenye tsi kavu ya mtsanga bada ya mimea yanjina kumala.

uses.en:
The dried peas are cooked in coconut milk as *mbaazi za nazi*, the classic coast breakfast with *mahamri*, the cardamom-scented fried dough.

Nothing goes to waste. The woody stems are used for firewood once the harvest is over, and the leaves are fed to livestock. Like other legumes, the plant fixes nitrogen and so enriches the soil it grows in.
uses.sw:
Mbaazi zilizokaushwa hupikwa kwa tui la nazi kama *mbaazi za nazi*, kifungua kinywa maarufu cha pwani pamoja na *mahamri*, maandazi yaliyokaangwa yenye harufu ya iliki.

Hakuna kinachopotea bure. Mashina magumu hutumika kama kuni mavuno yakishamalizika, na majani hulishwa mifugo. Kama mimea mingine ya jamii ya mikunde, mmea huu hufunga naitrojeni na hivyo hurutubisha udongo unaoota ndani yake.
uses.dg:
Mbalazi zikauma nkujitwa na huwi zichikala *mbaazi za nazi*, chai ya ligundzu ya kawaida ya pwani phamwenga na *mahamri*, mikahe ya kukalangwa yenye arufu ya iliki.

Takuna chitu chinachoangamika. Mihiye mifu nkuhumirwa dza kuni bada ya mavuno, na makodzage nkuriswa mifugo. Dza mimea yanjina ya jamii ya kunde, *m'balazi* unaika naitrojeni tsini na kpwa hivyo unaenjereza chinemi cha tsi ambamo unamera.

culture.en: The Mgombato dictionary uses this plant to illustrate a feature of Digo sound: *m'balazi*, with a short syllabic *m* before *b*, is the plant, while *mbalazi* is the pea itself.
culture.sw: Kamusi ya Mgombato inatumia mmea huu kuonyesha sifa moja ya sauti za Kidigo: *m'balazi*, yenye *m* fupi ya silabi kabla ya *b*, ni mmea, huku *mbalazi* ikiwa ni mbaazi yenyewe.
culture.dg: Mgombato unahumira muhi uhu kuonyesa dzambo ra sauti za Chidigo: *m'balazi*, yenye *m* fupi ya silabi mbere ya *b*, ni muhi, na *mbalazi* ni tembe yenye.

names.en: Digo: *m'balazi* (the plant) and *mbalazi* (the pea). Giriama, Chonyi and Kambe also say *mbalazi*. Swahili: *mbaazi*. English: pigeon pea. Scientists call it *Cajanus cajan*. Mgombato also applies *m'balazi* to the wild pigeon pea, *Eriosema psoraleoides*.
names.sw: Kidigo: *m'balazi* (mmea) na *mbalazi* (mbaazi). Kigiriama, Kichonyi na Kikambe pia husema *mbalazi*. Kiswahili: *mbaazi*. Kiingereza: *pigeon pea*. Wanasayansi huuita *Cajanus cajan*. Mgombato pia hutumia *m'balazi* kwa mbaazi mwitu, *Eriosema psoraleoides*.
names.dg: Kpwa Chidigo: *m'balazi* (muhi) na *mbalazi* (tembe). Agiriama, Achonyi na Akambe nao anaamba *mbalazi*. Kpwa Chiswahili unaihwa *mbaazi*, kpwa Chingereza *pigeon pea*. Kpwa chisayansi unaihwa *Cajanus cajan*. Mgombato piya unaiha mbalazi tsaka, *Eriosema psoraleoides*, kukala *m'balazi*.

reason.en: Cowpea, another pulse cooked in coconut milk
reason.sw: Kunde, jamii nyingine ya kunde inayopikwa kwa tui la nazi
reason.dg: Kunde, mbeyu zanjina za jamii ya kunde zinazojitwa na huwi

reason.sw: Pojo, jamii nyingine ya kunde ya pwani
reason.dg: Podzo, mbeyu zanjina za pwani za jamii ya kunde

reason.en: Lablab bean, a fellow farm legume
reason.sw: Fiwi, mmea mwenzake wa jamii ya mikunde shambani
reason.dg: Mpupu, mmea wanjina wa jamii ya kunde wa mndani

reason.en: Coconut, whose milk makes mbaazi za nazi
reason.sw: Mnazi, ambao tui lake hutengeneza mbaazi za nazi
reason.dg: Mnazi, ambao huwi ra nazize ndiro rinarohenda *mbaazi za nazi*

definition.en: Pigeon peas, the seeds; the plant is m'balazi.
definition.sw: Mbaazi, yaani mbegu; mmea ni m'balazi.

mgombato: m'balazi (mi) pigeon pea plant (Cajanus cajun; also wild pigeon pea, Eriosema psoraleoides); mbaazi (mti).
